summary: A crypto trader lost more than two hundred thousand dollars after attackers gained direct private key access to wallets originally generated through a Telegram trading bot workflow. The compromised wallets were drained across Ethereum Base and BSC through manually signed transactions without malicious token approvals or smart contract exploits.
user_mistake: generated or stored trading wallets through Telegram bot infrastructure
prevention: store long term assets in hardware wallets outside Telegram bot ecosystems/use isolated burner wallets for Telegram trading bots
